verdict.rationale: Bevy's game logic is written in plain, statically typed Rust (components are Rust structs, systems are normal Rust functions), and Bevy ships as a normal Rust crate with in-depth type, trait and method reference docs, plus static, crawlable docs.rs API docs. That gives an agent typed API definitions to work against. However, nothing in the evidence documents a language server or editor integration that provides completions, diagnostics, or navigation, and pre-1.0 breaking changes in each release weaken how reliable those typed APIs are for agents. Missing for 10: evidenced official or recommended LSP integration, documented completions/diagnostics/navigation workflow, hands-on corroboration of agent editor tooling.
